newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 25.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 25.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
-- US President Bill Clinton may visit Hungary following the July NATO summit.
-- The German government said that the NATO should take up five new members in the first wave of its enlargement instead of three.
-- Interior Minister Gabor Kuncze said the election law could be amended only with the agreement of the majority of the seven parties in the parliamnet.
-- Industry Minister Szabolcs Fazakas said that Hungary did not plan to take any extaordinary exchange rate policy measures.
-- The system of automatic promotion in rank for army officers will be abolished.
